meta.site_title: REXAM — Aapke liye Government Exams & Scholarships
meta.site_description: Apne qualifications ke hisab se sarkari naukri, exams aur scholarships khojein. Hum official notice ke hisab se age, qualification aur category check karte hain.

disclaimer.top_banner: REXAM ek independent student platform hai, koi sarkari website nahi. Apply karne se pehle hamesha official notification zaroor verify karein.
disclaimer.footer_notice: REXAM koi official government website nahi hai. Hum official government portals se publicly published notifications ikattha karte hain. Candidates apply karne se pehle sabhi dates, rules aur instructions official notification se zaroor check karein.
disclaimer.sensitive_field_note: Sirf eligibility check karne ke liye use hota hai
disclaimer.tracked_organisations_label: Hum in official bodies ke notifications track karte hain:

common.search_placeholder: Exam, post ya department search karein...

home.hero_title: Jaaniye kaun se sarkari exams ke liye aap eligible hain
home.hero_subtitle: Apni qualification, age aur state bas ek baar enter karein. Hum UPSC, SSC, Railways aur State PSCs ke official notification check karke wahi exams aur scholarships dikhayenge jismein aap genuinely qualify karte hain.
home.how_it_works_subtitle: 4 aasan steps mein apne profile se match hone wale sarkari exams aur scholarships paayein.
home.step_1_desc: Apni age, state, qualification aur category dalein. Sirf 2 minute lagte hain.
home.step_2_desc: Govt portals ke official advertisements se eligibility rules automatically match hote hain.
home.step_3_desc: Har listing par saaf dikhta hai: Eligible, Not eligible, ya Need more info sath mein exact reason ke saath.
home.step_4_title: Direct official portal par apply karein
home.step_4_desc: Bina kisi fees ya bicholiye ke seedha official government application portal par jaayein.
home.featured_subtitle: Central ministries aur state commissions se haal hi mein jaari huye official notifications.
home.trust_no_middleman: Sirf official links. Hum kabhi koi extra charges ya form fees nahi lete.
home.trust_transparent: Har eligibility result ka poora breakdown taaki aapko pata ho aap kyon qualify karte hain.

dashboard.showing_for: {{state}} ke opportunities dikhaye ja rahe hain
dashboard.matching_subtitle: Aapki qualifications aur age (statutory relaxations ke saath) match hone wale opportunities.
dashboard.no_matches_title: Filhal koi open match nahi mila
dashboard.no_matches_desc: Aaj aapki exact qualification se match hone wali koi active vacancy nahi mili. Sabhi listings dekhein ya profile update karein.
dashboard.not_eligible_notice: Yeh opportunities age limit ya specific degree requirements ki wajah se aapke profile ke liye match nahi hoti. Poori transparency ke liye hum inhe yahan display karte hain.
dashboard.missing_profile_title: Verification ke liye profile details zaroori hain
dashboard.missing_profile_desc: Kripya apni Date of Birth ya educational qualifications update karein taaki hum eligibility calculate kar sakein.
dashboard.profile_complete: Aapki profile complete hai! Sabhi available opportunities evaluate ho chuki hain.
dashboard.no_saved_title: Abhi tak koi opportunity save nahi ki
dashboard.no_saved_desc: Explorer ya Eligible tab se opportunities bookmark karke yahan track karein.
dashboard.no_applied_title: Abhi tak koi application track nahi ho rahi
dashboard.no_applied_desc: Jin exams ke liye apply kiya hai unka admit card aur result status yahan track karein.

wizard.title: Candidate Profile Setup
wizard.step1_sub: Aapka naam aur age official notification ke minimum aur maximum age criteria se check kiye jaate hain.
wizard.step2_sub: Government reservation rules ke mutabiq age aur fee relaxations apply karne ke liye zaroori hai.
wizard.step3_sub: Aapki degree ko official advertisements ke minimum qualification requirements se match kiya jata hai.
wizard.step4_sub: Final year appearing ya passed eligibility check karne ke liye.
